public class Merchant extends WanderingActor
Represents a wandering Merchant ('$') who offers buying and selling actions to adjacent actors on the map.

  • Constructor Details

    • Merchant

      public Merchant(Purchasable... offerings)
      Creates a new Merchant. The purchasable offerings are injected by the caller, so Merchant depends only on the Purchasable abstraction rather than on concrete products (Dependency Inversion), and different Merchants can carry different catalogs without modifying this class (Open/Closed).
      Parameters:
      offerings - the purchasable products offered by this Merchant

  • Method Details

    • allowableActions

      public ActionList allowableActions(Actor otherActor, String direction, GameMap map)
      Returns a collection of actions that an adjacent Actor can perform with this Merchant, including buying products from the catalog and selling any Sellable items currently in the other Actor's inventory.
      Overrides:
      allowableActions in class Actor
      Parameters:
      otherActor - the Actor that might perform an action
      direction - String representing the direction of the other Actor
      map - current GameMap
      Returns:
      a collection of available BuyAction and SellAction instances
